verdict.rationale: cubic documents an official CLI that reviews local changes before you push and generates a prompt your coding agent can use to fix the findings. It recommends connecting Codex or Claude Code for stronger review models, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. The evidence covers only that single local-review use case. missing for 10: CLI breadth beyond local review (e.g. triggering PR reviews or scans, querying findings), install and command reference details, machine-readable or non-interactive output documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
